meta.head: ed9926db
meta.method: Every examples/**/*.json parsed; project scene references read from assets.scene.path (string or {path}), assets.audio/environment, sequence.scenes[].file and every string ending in a file extension (resolved relative to the file, then the repo root); scene->scene/rig/material references followed transitively. Grouping: one record per distinct scene; projects over the same scene file (lighting/camera/song variants), phase iterations and generator presets are variant_files of their parent. Status: generated-missing = a referenced scene file is gitignored and absent on a clean checkout; not-indexed = reviewable but absent from examples/index.json. Category by intended use: Live = made for real-time audio/MIDI play (index live:true / sonic.live); Offline = rendered video, showcase, look-dev, lab, benchmark.

classes.A: easy/standalone: no code/test/tool reference beyond the index entry and docs
classes.B: minor cleanup: skip-tolerant example lists, count/name assertions, own generator, docs
classes.C: needs test/benchmark/lab migration: a test, lab or tool asserts on this scene's content
classes.D: significant shared dependency or unique engine functionality: src hard-codes it by name, it is the sole user of an engine subsystem, or many tests/tools/scenes depend on it
classes.E: unclear: cannot be inspected (generated-missing) or status undecided

meta.caveat: References are textual matches (file path, basename with directory confirmation, distinctive ids/display names) with known false positives removed; generic sweeps that include every example are listed separately. Line numbers are at HEAD ed9926db.
